followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/verification_recovery, separate same-model context
followup_reviews.Research finding: Cancellation of the 2017 Nathu La pilgrimage and actual 2018 passage are supported. They are not the separate COVID-era authorised-trade episode SA027. Indian pilgrimage groups travelling through Nathu La into China. Lipulekh remained a distinct operating pilgrimage route. No claim covers all cross-border trade or ordinary travel. P1 confirms cancellation as of 30 June 2017, without converting the scheduled 20 June trip into a first denied day. P2 retains actual first reported 2018 passage on 20 June. The annual June–September season prevents treating the intervening winter as continuous operational closure. The parliamentary answer reports China’s safe-conduct explanation. Keep the broad rationale uncoded rather than treating the military-standoff context as an independently established official interstate-pressure motive. The relevant parliamentary passages, cancellation dispatch, actual-passage report and seasonality answer were freshly read. PTI is the origin for two news articles; they concern different dated observations, not automatically independent origins. The same researcher’s earlier R02 role is disclosed. Both phases remain unlocated pending B01. The pilgrimage route is identified, but no crossing coordinate or gate geometry is certified by this audit.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge

Withdraw the unsupported Beitbridge cargo endpoint and exact Sadao duration, retain the Benapole quarantine, recognise the observed Rumichaca reopening and append the accessible Korala report. Apply the challenger’s medical-visa cohort, shared-reporting inference and unread-translation metadata refinements. Unknown dates, continuity, exceptions, missing source access and geographic limits remain explicit. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not a certification that all attributes are known or that the full register has been freshly verified.
